rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something discreet and not drawing attention.

example.english: The new fan is tucked in the corner, so it is quite unobtrusive.
example.traditional: 部新風扇擺喺角落，幾唔覺眼。
example.jyutping: bou6 san1 fung1 sin3 baai2 hai2 gok3 lok6 gei2 m4 gok3 ngaan5

rows.note: Use this especially when something is visually inconspicuous or not noticeable.

example.english: This sign is very unobtrusive from a distance.
example.traditional: 呢塊門牌顏色好淡，遠睇唔顯眼。
example.jyutping: ne1 faai3 mun4 paai4 ngaan4 sik1 hou2 daam6 jyun5 tai2 m4 hin2 ngaan5

rows.note: Use this for a person, style, or action that deliberately keeps a low profile rather than attracting attention.

example.english: They are very unobtrusive and never try to steal the limelight.
example.traditional: 佢做人好低調，從來唔會搶風頭。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 jan4 hou2 dai1 diu6 cung4 loi4 m4 wui5 coeng2 fung1 tau4
